deals.evidence: o City Football Group (CFG) adquiriu 90% da Sociedade Anônima de Futebol (SAF) do Bahia
deals.headline: City Football Group completes purchase of 90% of Bahia SAF
deals.summary: CFG took 90% of the newly formed Esporte Clube Bahia S.A.F.; the association keeps 10%. CFG Brazil subscribed R$321.19m of capital, R$190m paid on signing and the rest payable within three years. Press reported the deal as worth about $200m (FOS, citing The Athletic). Members approved it with 99% on 3 Dec 2022.

deals.headline: CFG converts R$906.7m of intercompany funding into an advance for future capital increase (AFAC)
deals.source_name: Esporte Clube Bahia S.A.F. demonstrações financeiras 2025 (auditadas, RSM), nota 1.3 / 16.2
deals.summary: During 2025 the controlling shareholder's intercompany funding of R$906.718m was reclassified as AFAC in equity, to be capitalised; R$131.19m of it pays up capital already subscribed, the rest awaits a shareholder resolution.

name: Esporte Clube Bahia S.A.F.
notes: Accounts are calendar-year (2025) for Esporte Clube Bahia S.A.F., figures in R$ thousands in the PDF (converted to full units only by ×1000). Revenue is net revenue (receita líquida); gross revenue was R$393.338m; player-trading income (R$168.944m) sits in other operating income, not revenue. Stadium is branded 'Casa de Apostas Arena Fonte Nova'. Shirt sponsor not recorded: Viva Sorte Bet left the shirt in January 2026 and Esportiva Bet signed a three-month master deal in April 2026 (Máquina do Esporte); current sponsor unconfirmed. Attendance: the annual report says only 'média superior a 38 mil pagantes por partida' (no exact figure). Social counts are the annual report's approximate year-end-2025 figures. CFG's own owners (Newton/Sheikh Mansour majority, Silver Lake ~17%) hold Bahia only indirectly; no look-through stake is stated. The Libra–Mubadala Capital exclusivity (20% of league commercial rights) was not found as a closed transaction and is not recorded. Betting sponsors: a provisional measure (MP) announced 25 Sep 2026 bans betting operators and their advertising in Brazil from 6 Oct 2026 (Máquina/MKT Esportivo, 2 Oct 2026), so a betting-house shirt sponsor may not survive the season.
